instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. Outdoors at night near a lit glass greenhouse, a laughing woman in a light lavender shirt (R1) steers a bicycle, looking to the left. Behind her, a man in a light blazer (R2) stands closely, hands on the handlebars, looking ahead with a warm smile. Warm side lighting highlights their expressions against the dark background.
